reported_results.compatibility_scope: Rule-based property/unit compatibility screening is separate from numeric parsing and unit recognition; it is not independent verification of the reported measurements.

selection_protocol: Enumerate the specimen-to-result information lifecycle present in the sanitized workbook.
Score each scientific relation or value pattern once over the full eight-record population; do not repeat it as global and per-record questions.
Derive every requirement from information present in the application lifecycle and label it by scientific function, never by ontology origin.
Include selected-profile native vocabulary coverage as an explicit scored requirement rather than an unscored post hoc argument.
Generate expected rows from the manifest before executing ontology-specific SPARQL or native-pattern assessment.
Compare deduplicated result sets after normalizing numeric lexical forms only; preserve all other selected values exactly.
Treat numeric parsing and recognized-unit mapping separately from rule-based property/unit compatibility screening.
Disallow local semantic bridge predicates and report shared standards and declared imports separately.
Credit generic native patterns as successful while reporting their semantic specificity separately from specialised native patterns.
benchmark_contract.inference_scope: The resulting requirement-satisfaction decisions apply only to these thirteen frozen retrieval, native-pattern, and vocabulary-coverage assessments over eight source records representing seven unique profiles.

conclusion_rules.criterion: CHAMEO is exact for measurement context, setting identity, preparation, processing, software, analysis lineage, result generation, workflow/task grouping, and technique/occurrence separation.
CHAMEO supplies specialised workflow/task and technique-description patterns; H2KG can group activities generically but lacks a separate technique-description pattern.

H2KG is exact, while no declared ancestry-compatible path from a CHAMEO measurement-parameter record to a distinct valued scientific characteristic was identified under the benchmark's permitted native-encoding rules.
H2KG is exact for individual result/property/bearer associations and parsed numeric values with recognized units, while CHAMEO is not exact for the individual association contract.
H2KG has greater native class coverage at the predefined profile granularity than CHAMEO for the selected source records.

balanced_conclusion.statement: For the selected characterization profiles, the benchmark supports a scoped complementarity conclusion: CHAMEO provides explicit characterization-methodology structures, while H₂KG provides greater native class coverage at the predefined profile granularity together with direct valued-parameter and individually provenance-linked result patterns.
balanced_conclusion.scope: The 12/13 and 10/13 values are requirement-satisfaction rates under this frozen protocol, not general ontology-accuracy or quality scores. The benchmark covers eight source records representing seven unique profiles; governance, maintainability, reasoning performance, usability, and scalability were not measured.

legacy_h2kg_application_contract.design_provenance: The 50 questions predate the CHAMEO encoding and were inherited from the H2KG characterization application. They are source-grounded but not blinded, independently authored, or neutral with respect to H2KG's design.

benchmark_policy.requirement_selection: Thirteen requirements derived from the source characterization lifecycle and named by scientific function; every requirement is scored once over all eight source records, representing seven unique profiles, and none is selected by ontology origin.
benchmark_policy.comparison_method: Deduplicated result-set equality after numeric lexical normalization for query-based requirements; explicit native-pattern assessment for unsupported-query cases; native vocabulary coverage for the selected profiles.
benchmark_policy.quantity_interpretation: Numeric parsing and recognized-unit mapping are distinct from rule-based scientific property/unit compatibility screening.
benchmark_policy.conclusion_rule: The complementarity statement is emitted only when every explicit machine-checkable decision rule passes.
benchmark_policy.legacy_question_set_status: Retained as a historical asymmetric transfer-test diagnostic and excluded from the primary conclusion.
